heading: 2. Authentication And Trust Boundary
text:
2. Authentication And Trust Boundary

The gateway authenticates browser-facing `/api/**` requests with
`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`, with these exceptions:

| Endpoint class | Auth behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/users/register` | Public |
| `POST /api/users/login` | Public |
| `POST /api/admin/login` | Public admin credential exchange |
| `GET /api/products` and `GET /api/products/{productId}` | Public catalog read |
| `GET /api/inventories/{productId}` | Public stock read |
| `OPTIONS /api/**` | Public CORS preflight |

All `/api/admin/**` routes require an ADMIN JWT except `POST /api/admin/login`
and CORS preflight. Valid USER tokens receive HTTP 403.

Incoming browser-supplied `X-User-Id`, `X-Username`, `X-User-Role`,
`X-Internal-Token`, `X-Forwarded-For`, and `X-Gateway-Client-Ip` headers are
always removed. For authenticated requests, the gateway injects trusted identity
headers parsed from the JWT, the configured internal token, and a gateway-derived
`X-Gateway-Client-Ip` audit header before forwarding downstream. Browser code
must send only the Bearer token, never trusted propagation or audit headers.
The internal token is required outside tests: the gateway and downstream
services fail closed when it is missing unless an explicit legacy test switch is
enabled.

Authentication failures return `ApiResponse` JSON with stable `UNAUTHORIZED`
or `FORBIDDEN` codes.

heading: 3. Response And Pagination Rules
text:
3. Response And Pagination Rules

Every REST API response uses `ApiResponse<T>`:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "code": "0",
  "message": "success",
  "data": {}
}
```

Paginated list endpoints return `ApiResponse<PageResponse<T>>`. Pagination is
Spring pageable based: `page` is 0-based, `size` controls page size, and `sort`
may be accepted where the controller uses `Pageable`.

Common error codes:

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `40000` | Bad request |
| `40001` | Validation failed |
| `40100` | Unauthorized |
| `40300` | Forbidden |
| `40400` | Resource not found |
| `40900` | Conflict |
| `40901` | Order has been cancelled |
| `40902` | Order status does not allow payment |
| `40903` | Payment already successful; retained for compatibility, while repeated successful `POST /api/payments/{orderNo}/pay` now returns `200` with the original payment |
| `42900` | Too many requests |
| `50000` | Internal server error |

heading: 5. Non-Browser Contracts
text:
5. Non-Browser Contracts

`/internal/**` endpoints are service-to-service only. They are not routed by
the gateway, browser code must not call them, and AI code must not call them.
Examples include:

| Internal path | Owner | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /internal/products/{productId}` | product-service | Order-service product lookup. |
| `POST /internal/inventories/deduct` | inventory-service | Order-service inventory deduction. |
| `POST /internal/inventories/release` | inventory-service | Order-service inventory release. |

RabbitMQ events, such as `payment.success`, are also internal contracts and are
not browser-facing APIs.

heading: 6. Browser Support, Rate Limiting, And Logging
text:
6. Browser Support, Rate Limiting, And Logging

CORS applies to `/api/**` and is configured with
`MINIMALL_GATEWAY_CORS_*` environment variables. Preflight requests are
completed before route, authentication, or rate-limit processing.

The gateway applies Redis-backed token-bucket rate limiting to `/api/**`
requests except preflight requests. Authenticated requests are keyed by trusted
user ID. Public requests fall back to client IP data. Rate-limit denials return
an `ApiResponse` JSON body with `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` and HTTP 429.

Gateway request logs include method, browser-facing path, status, and duration.
They do not log `Authorization`, `X-User-Id`, `X-Username`, or other request
headers.

heading: Runtime Topology
text:
Runtime Topology

```text
Browser or k6 client
        |
        v
api-gateway :8080
        |
        +--> user-service :8101
        +--> product-service :8102
        +--> inventory-service :8103
        +--> order-service :8104
        +--> payment-service :8105

notification-service :8106 consumes payment events without a public gateway route.

Shared local dependencies:
MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Prometheus, Grafana
```

The gateway is the only browser-facing API entrypoint. It validates JWTs,
removes browser-supplied `X-User-Id` and `X-Username` headers, injects trusted
user headers for authenticated downstream requests, applies CORS, and performs
Redis-backed rate limiting.

No `/internal/**` route is exposed through the gateway. Internal service APIs
are only for service-to-service calls inside the backend network.

heading: Data Model
text:
Data Model

The local MVP uses one MySQL schema configured by `MYSQL_DATABASE`. The initial
schema migration is:

```text
docs/sql/migrations/V1__initial_schema.sql
```

Core tables:

- `users`
- `products`
- `inventory`
- `inventory_records`
- `orders`
- `order_events`
- `payments`
- `notification_logs`

The baseline constraints and migration naming rules are documented in
`docs/sql/README.md`.

heading: Event Flow
text:
Event Flow

`payment-service` publishes successful payment events to RabbitMQ after a
payment is committed as successful.

```text
payment-service
  exchange: minimall.payment.exchange
  routing key: payment.success
        |
        +--> minimall.order.payment-success.queue
        |       consumed by order-service
        |
        +--> minimall.notification.payment-success.queue
                consumed by notification-service
```

Consumers must deduplicate by `eventId` because RabbitMQ delivery is
at-least-once. The full topology, payload, producer rules, consumer rules, and
versioning policy are documented in `docs/messaging/payment-success-event.md`.

heading: Startup Order
text:
Startup Order

For a new local environment, start infrastructure before Java services:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env up -d mysql redis rabbitmq prometheus grafana
```

Wait until the dependency containers are healthy:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env ps
```

Apply the schema when the MySQL data volume is new or empty:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env exec -T mysql sh -lc 'mysql -u"$MYSQL_USER" -p"$MYSQL_PASSWORD" "$MYSQL_DATABASE"' < docs/sql/migrations/V1__initial_schema.sql
```

Build all service jars:

```bash
mvn clean package -DskipTests
```

Start Java services:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env --profile services up -d --build
```

The Compose dependency order is:

1. `mysql`, `redis`, `rabbitmq`
2. `prometheus`
3. `grafana`
4. `user-service`, `product-service`, `inventory-service`, `payment-service`, `notification-service`
5. `order-service`
6. `api-gateway`

`order-service` waits for product, inventory, Redis, RabbitMQ, and MySQL health.
`api-gateway` waits for Redis and the routed downstream services.

heading: Database Operations
text:
Database Operations

The migration assets live under:

```text
docs/sql/migrations/
```

The current baseline migration is:

```text
docs/sql/migrations/V1__initial_schema.sql
```

The schema contains the MVP tables and uniqueness constraints documented in
`docs/sql/README.md`. Re-run the migration only when it is safe for the target
database. Local disposable data can be reset with:

```bash
docker compose down -v
```

Then repeat the startup and migration steps.

heading: RabbitMQ Operations
text:
RabbitMQ Operations

RabbitMQ management is published at:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:${RABBITMQ_MANAGEMENT_PORT}
```

Use the local credentials from `.env`.

Payment success events use:

- Exchange: `minimall.payment.exchange`
- Routing key: `payment.success`
- Order queue: `minimall.order.payment-success.queue`
- Notification queue: `minimall.notification.payment-success.queue`

`payment-service` is the only producer. `order-service` and
`notification-service` are idempotent consumers keyed by `eventId`. The payload
contract and versioning rules are in `docs/messaging/payment-success-event.md`.

`infra/prometheus/prometheus.yml` now uses Docker Compose service names for Java
service scrape targets. This is the stable path for Docker Desktop + WSL because
Prometheus and the Java services share the same Compose network.

When Java services run directly inside WSL while Prometheus runs in Docker
Desktop, `host.docker.internal` can resolve to the Windows/Docker Desktop host
rather than the WSL VM. In that setup, Prometheus may register host-based
targets but show them as down. Keep any host-based Prometheus override local and
outside Git.

For a deliberately host-run service, keep any host-based scrape override local
and verify it with placeholders for that environment:

1. Start one service outside Compose, for example `inventory-service`.
2. Confirm that same host environment can read `http://<service-host>:<service-port>/actuator/prometheus`.
3. Find the current WSL IP with `hostname -I`.
4. From the Prometheus container, test `http://<wsl-ip>:<service-port>/actuator/prometheus`.

The WSL IP is environment-specific and can change after restart, so do not commit
it into `infra/prometheus/prometheus.yml`. Use the checked-in Compose service
targets for stable project verification.

heading: AI 库存助手真实模型冒烟测试问题与修复规划

- 背景：Phase 3 验收（13/13）后的首次真实 LLM 端到端冒烟。MOCK 路径全绿；以下问题

heading: P2. 问答偶发「limitations must be an array」
text:
P2. 问答偶发「limitations must be an array」

- 现象：带商品 ID 提问时模型输出被结构校验拒绝。
- 根因：prompt 未强制 `limitations` 的类型；DeepSeek 有时返回字符串。
- 修复：prompt v2 明确「`limitations` 必须是 JSON 字符串数组；没有局限时输出 []」。
  校验器不放松。

heading: P4. 中英文夹杂，对使用者不友好
text:
P4. 中英文夹杂，对使用者不友好

- 现象：分析摘要、建议说明、数据范围、数据局限大量英文。
- 根因：① 四个 prompt 均未规定输出语言，DeepSeek 默认英文；② 后端硬编码英文文案——
  证据 limitations（"Sales evidence is limited to..."）、建议 `inputSummary`
  （"Replenishment evidence: ..."）、日报 limitations（`AiDailyInventoryReportService`）。
- 修复：① prompt v2 要求所有自然语言字段（summary/answer/reason/limitations）使用
  简体中文；② 上述后端硬编码文案全部中文化（仅文案，不改结构与字段名）。

heading: 附带观察（并入 P5 验证）
text:
附带观察（并入 P5 验证）

- 热销分析「分析明细」中可用/安全有值但销量、风险、说明为「—」——即 P5③ 的可选
  回显问题，修复后应消失。
- 补货建议把库存健康的热销品（HOT-MUG，可用 42 > 安全 10）也列入补货——模型判断
  层面的激进，不违反校验；P5② 公式锚定后应只在覆盖天数不足时出现。

heading: 逐服务评价
text:
逐服务评价

| 服务 | 职责 | 评价 |
|---|---|---|
| api-gateway | JWT 校验、伪造头剥离、ADMIN 路径拦截、内部路径封锁、限流、CORS | **架构最强的一环**。`GatewayAuthenticationFilter` 先剥离 4 个信任头再注入（:90-105），网关层就拒绝 USER 访问 `/api/admin/**`（:67） |
| user-service | 注册/登录/admin 登录/审计日志查询 | 合理。BCrypt、`adminLogin` 单独校验 `UserRole.ADMIN`、管理员种子由环境变量控制 |
| product-service | 商品 CRUD、上下架、`/internal/products` 快照 | 合理，user/admin/internal 三层控制器分离清晰 |
| inventory-service | 库存 + 入库单 + AI 建议 + **整个 AI 助手** | 职责最重。AI 放这里符合 PRD §7 的论证（避免新增分布式事务边界），当前规模下可接受，不建议拆 |
| order-service | 订单 + 状态机 + 超时取消 + 销量统计 | 合理。依赖方向正确: order→product/inventory 单向 HTTP |
| payment-service | 支付 + 事件发布 | **有边界违规**，见下 |
| notification-service | 消费事件 + 通知日志 | 合理且最小 |
| common-core/auth | 响应/异常/审计契约/JWT/信任过滤器 | 未膨胀，全是真实共享物 |

heading: 与 AI 助手的耦合
text:
与 AI 助手的耦合

AI 代码对库存写路径**零耦合**——AI 包内没有任何 repository 写调用，唯一写路径 `AiOperationSuggestionService`/`InboundOrderDraftService` 都要求 `InventoryAdminAuditContext`（即真实管理员身份）。

`OrderServiceSalesEvidenceClient` 直连 order-service 端口的 `/api/admin/operation-stats/sales-by-product`（带 `X-Internal-Token` + UserContext 透传）——这是服务间调用，没违反"浏览器只走网关"，但复用 admin 路径而非 `/internal/**` 与项目自身惯例不一致，需要能解释（解释方向: 复用同一套 ADMIN 鉴权语义，避免为只读统计开第二个信任通道）。

**结论: 不是"被 AI 写乱的架构"。** 边界一致、依赖单向、惯例统一（每个服务同构的 AdminAccess/审计/异常模式），dev-log 与代码三方可互证。上面三个问题是设计取舍级别，不是混乱。

---

heading: 关键问题逐条回答
text:
关键问题逐条回答

- **触发方式**: 管理员经网关调 REST（Q&A 是 POST 提问；分析是 POST 端点）。无定时任务、无自主触发。✅ 符合 PRD。
- **输出是否落库**: **否**。Q&A 和低库存分析结果只返回不落库。`ai_operation_suggestion` 表和全套元数据列已就绪，但**没有任何生产代码写入它**（Task 8 未做）。这是当前最大断裂点: 审批流是"有审批无来源"。
- **是否进入审批流/管理员确认后能否执行**: 后端 API 全通（reject/convert/confirm），前端全无。
- **分析过程有无日志审计**: 建议生命周期有完整审计；但分析调用本身（谁在何时问了什么、模型答了什么）不持久化——只有最终落库的建议会带 prompt_version/model 元数据。
- **AI 输出无法落地?** 不是"无法"，是"还没接"——分析响应里有 riskLevel/reason/items，与建议表字段一一对应，Task 8 是纯粹的"把已校验输出写进已建好的表"。

heading: 是否需要重构？
text:
是否需要重构？

**判定: 第 1 类——方向正确，继续补完。不要推翻，不要局部重构。**

- **保留**: 全部。Provider 抽象、validator、证据门面、Phase 2.5 审批链、契约文档体系。
- **应重构**: 无结构性重构必要。唯一建议改动是 `MockAiProvider`: 让它基于输入快照生成合理 items（取 evidence 里真实 productId、`suggestedQuantity = max(safetyStock*2 - available, 1)` 之类的确定性规则），否则 MOCK 模式下 Task 8 产出的建议永远没有条目、`convertToInboundDraft` 直接抛 "no items to convert"。
- **应删除/合并**: 无。Q&A 双测试文件（`AiInventoryQuestionServiceTest`/`AiInventoryQuestionAnalysisServiceTest`）分工不同（意图层 vs 分析接线层），保留。
- **马上补齐**: Task 7.2 → 8 → 9（后端闭环），然后 Task 10（UI）。
- **暂缓**: Task 11 日报、滞销分析、趋势图。
- **不建议扩展**: 自主 agent/工具循环、独立 ai-assistant-service、向量检索/RAG。

---

heading: 第六部分：安全风险分级
text:
第六部分：安全风险分级

**High（GitHub/演示前必须修）: 未发现。** 专项核对过: 无硬编码密钥（`.env` 被 gitignore 且未被 git 跟踪、`.env.example` 全是 change-me 占位、AI key 走 `AI_API_KEY` 环境变量）；JWT 强制 secret、角色进 claim、过期校验；CORS 默认仅 localhost 且 credentials=false；无 IDOR（订单/支付都绑 userId）；AI 端点双层 ADMIN；validator 阻止输出泄露内部信息。

**Medium（正式展示前建议修）**:

| # | 问题 | 位置 | 风险 | 建议 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | internal secret 未配置时信任伪造头 | `common-auth/.../UserContextFilter.trustsPropagationHeaders` | 非 compose 部署可伪造 ADMIN | **已修复（2026-06-29）：默认 fail-closed，测试/legacy 显式 opt-in** |
| M2 | 订单创建 saga 缺口（先扣后存） | `OrderCommandService.createNewOrder:121` | 锁定库存泄漏 | 至少 README 已知限制；或加孤儿释放兜底任务 |
| M3 | payment 直读 orders 表 | `payment/domain/Order.java` | 边界违规 + schema 漂移风险 | 改为调 order-service 接口，或文档明示取舍 |
| M4 | 业务数据外发第三方 LLM | `OpenAiCompatibleAiProvider` | 库存/销量数据出境到 DeepSeek/MiniMax | README 声明 + 演示默认 MOCK |
| M5 | 契约漂移: low-stock-analysis 契约写 GET、实现为 POST | `phase3-ai-inventory-contract.md:173` vs `AdminAiInventoryAnalysisController` | 违反契约文档自己的更新规则 | 改契约文档（一行事） |

**Low**: 限流 fail-open 默认值；MQ 无死信队列；JWT 无刷新/吊销机制（1h 过期可接受）。`X-Forwarded-For` 控制审计 IP 字段的问题已在 2026-06-30 修复：gateway 默认剥离浏览器传入的 forwarded/audit IP headers，并只在 internal token 校验通过后让下游采信 gateway 注入的 `X-Gateway-Client-Ip`。

---

heading: 1. 总体结论
text:
1. 总体结论

**较完整简历项目**（介于"较完整简历项目"与"接近企业级展示项目"之间）。一句话: **工程纪律和安全边界已达到展示级，但 AI 助手"有审批无来源、有后端无界面"，闭环差最后三个任务，当前最大风险是"演示不出来"而不是"做得不对"。**

heading: 8. 演示流程建议
text:
8. 演示流程建议

1. 顾客端下单→支付→订单状态流转（展示幂等: 重复提交同 idempotencyKey）
2. 管理端登录（展示 USER token 调 admin 接口得 403）
3. 库存页看扣减流水
4. AI 页: 先问答（演示 unsupported 受控响应）→ 低库存分析（指出数据时间窗 + limitations + 证据并排）→ 生成补货建议
5. 审批: 驳回一条（看审计日志）、转化一条 → 入库草稿 → 确认 → 库存增加 + 流水 + 建议变 APPLIED
6. 审计日志页展示全链 AI_SUGGESTION 来源追踪
7. 架构讲解顺序: 网关信任模型 → 库存不变量 → AI 权限边界（"AI 只能建议，唯一加库存入口是管理员确认"）→ 反幻觉校验

heading: 10. 面试追问与回答方向
text:
10. 面试追问与回答方向

- **AI 智能在哪，为什么不是规则系统？** 规则只能输出"低于安全库存"；LLM 综合销量趋势、流水、缺数据情形生成解释性建议与风险分级；但校验是规则的——"生成靠模型、守门靠代码"，这句话就是设计核心。
- **AI 建议如何防止越权执行？** 三重: AI 代码无写依赖（编译期保证）、唯一加库存入口要求 ADMIN 上下文 + requestId、网关/下游双层鉴权有回归测试锁定。
- **如何保证库存一致性？** 条件 UPDATE 原子扣减 + (order_no, change_type) 唯一键 + 乐观锁版本；坦承 saga 缺口（M2）并说出补偿思路。
- **开发到一半如何判断要不要重构？** 本次审查就是答案: 对照锁定契约逐项核对实现、检查闭环断点位置、确认断点是"未完成"还是"做错了"——结论是补完不推翻。
- **哪些是你设计的？** 契约边界、信任模型、校验规则集是人决策；逐任务实现有 AI 辅助但每步有测试验收和 dev-log，这套"人定边界、AI 实现、测试守门"的流程本身值得讲。
- **需准备好的硬问题**: 为什么微服务共库（答: 演示成本取舍，表集逻辑隔离，payment 读表是已识别债务）；lockedStock 语义（答: 无发货环节的建模简化）。

heading: Architecture
text:
Architecture

This document summarizes the delivered MiniMall backend architecture and links
to the detailed contracts used by deployment, frontend integration, messaging,
and pressure testing.

heading: Request Flow
text:
Request Flow

Browser-facing routes use canonical gateway prefixes and are forwarded to the
matching downstream `/api/**` controller paths:

| Gateway prefix | Downstream service |
| --- | --- |
| `/api/users/**` | `user-service` |
| `/api/products/**` | `product-service` |
| `/api/inventories/**` | `inventory-service` |
| `/api/orders/**` | `order-service` |
| `/api/payments/**` | `payment-service` |

All REST APIs return the shared `ApiResponse` envelope. Business errors should
be represented with `BusinessException` and stable `ErrorCode` values. See
`docs/frontend-integration.md` for the frontend-facing envelope, error codes,
and example payloads.

heading: Observability And Pressure Testing
text:
Observability And Pressure Testing

Every Spring Boot service exposes:

- `/actuator/health`
- `/actuator/info`
- `/actuator/metrics`
- `/actuator/prometheus`

Prometheus scrapes Java service containers by Compose service name. Grafana is
provisioned with the `MiniMall Observability` dashboard. See
`docs/observability.md` for checks and Docker Desktop + WSL network notes.

Gateway pressure testing is defined in `pressure/mini-mall-gateway.js` and must
use `api-gateway` as the only API entrypoint. See `pressure/README.md` for k6
variables, thresholds, smoke runs, and bottleneck notes.

heading: minimall 代码架构体检报告
text:
minimall 代码架构体检报告

审查日期：2026-07-03
审查方式：只读代码架构体检（不修改任何代码、配置、文档、数据库迁移文件或测试文件）。基于当前分支 `codex/full-repo-audit` 工作区真实代码。仓库中已有一份 2026-06-29 的自审报告（`docs/audit/full-repo-audit.md`，其 P1/P2 项标记已修复），本报告为独立复查，结论以本次实际读到的代码为准。

---

heading: 2. 项目结构理解
text:
2. 项目结构理解

**主要模块**（均为实际观察）：

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `common-core` | `ApiResponse`/`PageResponse`、`BusinessException`/`ErrorCode`、`GlobalExceptionHandler`、支付事件 DTO、`JdbcAdminAuditWriter` 审计写入 |
| `common-auth` | `JwtUtils`（HMAC256）、`UserContextFilter`（网关密钥信任模型）、`InternalAuthFilter`（/internal 密钥校验）、`AdminRequestContextResolver` |
| `api-gateway` | Spring Cloud Gateway：路由、JWT 校验、剥离伪造头并注入可信头、`/internal` 阻断、Redis 限流、CORS |
| `user-service` | 注册/登录/admin 登录、BCrypt、审计日志查询、admin 种子账号 |
| `product-service` | 商品 CRUD（admin）+ 公开目录读 + Redis 缓存 + `/internal` 商品快照 |
| `inventory-service` | 库存查询/扣减/释放、入库单、AI 建议全生命周期、全部 `/api/admin/ai/**`（154 个 Java 文件，最大模块） |
| `order-service` | 下单/取消/超时取消调度、支付成功消费、销量统计 |
| `payment-service` | 支付创建（直接映射 `orders` 表，M3）、支付成功事件发布 |
| `notification-service` | 支付成功通知消费与日志 |
| `frontend` / `admin-frontend` | Vue 3 客户端商城 / Element Plus 管理后台，均只经网关（`http.ts` 统一处理 401 清 token 跳登录、429 提示） |

**主要业务链路**：注册/登录 → 浏览商品（游客可读）→ 下单（Redis 幂等锁 + DB 唯一键，远程扣库存）→ 15 分钟超时取消 → 模拟支付 → RabbitMQ 支付成功事件 → 订单置 PAID / 通知落库；管理后台：商品/库存/订单/支付/通知/审计；AI 链路：问答/低库存/热销分析 → 补货建议（PENDING_REVIEW）→ 审批 → 转入库草稿 → 确认入库（requestId 幂等）→ 库存增加 + 流水 + 审计 → 建议 APPLIED。

**数据库与中间件**：单 MySQL schema 全服务共享（`SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL` 共用一个锚点），`ddl-auto: none`，手工迁移 V1–V12；Redis（下单幂等锁、商品缓存、网关限流）；RabbitMQ（支付事件，common-core 统一拓扑）；Prometheus + Grafana。密钥全部 env 强制（`:?required`），compose 缺失即启动失败。

heading: P1-2：下单先远程扣库存、后本地插订单（已登记的 M2，确认仍存在）
text:
P1-2：下单先远程扣库存、后本地插订单（已登记的 M2，确认仍存在）

- **位置**：`order-service/.../service/OrderCommandService.java:118-138`——第 121 行 `inventoryClient.deduct(...)`，第 125 行才 `orderRepository.saveAndFlush(...)`
- **现象**：远程扣减不在本地事务的回滚范围内。订单插入失败（DB 抖动、非幂等键的完整性冲突、进程被杀）时，库存已锁定且带着一个不存在订单的 orderNo 流水，永远不会被释放——超时取消只扫描存在的订单。
- **风险**：孤儿锁定库存，可售库存虚减，需人工用 admin adjust 修复。
- **触发场景**：deduct 成功与 save 提交之间任何失败。
- **证据**：代码顺序如上；`changeInventory` 的幂等记录以 orderNo 为键，意味着孤儿流水可被追溯但无自动回收。
- **修复建议**（最小）：先插入订单（状态可为 PENDING_PAYMENT），再扣库存，扣减失败则本地事务回滚订单；或增加一个对账任务：扫描"有 DEDUCT 流水但无对应订单"的 orderNo 并自动 release。
- **是否必须立即修复**：否——这是 CLAUDE.md 已知问题登记表中的 M2，按项目规则需用户明确批准后才能动；但演示/面试时必须能讲清楚这个缺口和修法。

heading: P2-2：AI 反幻觉文本校验只覆盖英文，中文库存变更声明可穿透
text:
P2-2：AI 反幻觉文本校验只覆盖英文，中文库存变更声明可穿透

- **位置**：`inventory-service/.../ai/validation/AiModelOutputValidator.java:18-31`——`SQL_PATTERN`、`STOCK_CHANGE_CLAIM_PATTERN` 全部是英文词形（`changed|updated|deducted...`）
- **现象**：模型输出 summary 若写"已为您扣减库存 20 件"或"库存已更新"，不会命中任何 fail；而系统提示词、证据摘要（`inputSummary` 就是中文）都在引导中文输出，真实 provider 大概率返回中文。
- **风险**：前端会如实展示一条"AI 声称已执行库存变更"的叙述，违反"永远不能显示 AI 已执行库存变更"这条 UI 红线——虽然库存实际不会变，但演示可信度受损。
- **修复建议**：给两个 Pattern 补中文关键词（如 `库存.{0,6}(已|被)?(更新|扣减|调整|增加|减少|修改)`、`已(执行|确认|应用)`）。合同明确允许收紧校验器，这是合规改动。
- **是否必须立即修复**：接真实中文 provider 演示前应修；纯 MOCK 演示不受影响（MockAiProvider 输出可控）。
- **修复状态（2026-07-06）**：Phase C C1 已完成。`AiModelOutputValidator`
  已增补中文库存变更声明和中文内部细节关键词拦截，覆盖"库存已更新"、
  "已为您扣减库存 20 件"、"我已执行入库操作"、"内部接口/密钥/令牌"等文本；
  同时新增放行用例确认"建议补货"、"availableStock 低于 safetyStock"、
  "库存不足，存在缺货风险"不会被误杀。这是校验器收紧，不涉及 prompt
  文本或 `promptVersion` 变更。

heading: P2-4：重复支付返回 409 而非幂等重放，idempotencyKey 存而不用
text:
P2-4：重复支付返回 409 而非幂等重放，idempotencyKey 存而不用

- **修复状态（2026-07-06）**：Phase B B3 已完成。已有 SUCCESS 支付现在会在 `validatePayable` 前短路并返回原 `PaymentResponse`（HTTP 200、同一 `paymentNo`），不再抛 `PAYMENT_ALREADY_SUCCESS`。若订单仍为 `PENDING_PAYMENT`，重放路径会通过 B1 的 afterCommit 发布入口重发 `payment.success` 作为事件丢失自愈；若订单已 `PAID`，仅返回原支付单、不重发事件。`PAYMENT_ALREADY_SUCCESS` 错误码保留为兼容兜底，网关契约已同步。
- **位置**：`payment-service/.../service/PaymentCommandService.java:86-89`——已 SUCCESS 的 payment 再次 pay 抛 `PAYMENT_ALREADY_SUCCESS`；`idempotencyKey` 有唯一约束但从不作为查询键
- **现象**：与下单的幂等语义（同 key 重放返回原结果）不一致：客户端网络重试同一次支付会收到 409 错误而不是原支付结果。
- **风险**：用户侧"支付失败"的错觉；前端需要额外把 409 解释成"其实已支付"。数据不会坏（实际大多数情况订单已 PAID，会先命中 `ORDER_INVALID_STATE`）。
- **修复建议**：同 `idempotencyKey` 命中且已 SUCCESS 时返回原 `PaymentResponse` 而非抛异常。
- **是否必须立即修复**：否。

heading: P2-6：全服务共享单一 MySQL schema，payment-service 直接映射 orders 表（M3，确认仍存在）
text:
P2-6：全服务共享单一 MySQL schema，payment-service 直接映射 orders 表（M3，确认仍存在）

- **位置**：`docker-compose.yml:8`（单一 `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL` 锚点）、`payment-service/.../domain/Order.java:16-22`（只读映射他服务的表）
- **现象**：微服务边界在 API 层清晰，在数据层是逻辑单体。payment 读 orders 绕过了 order-service 的服务边界。
- **风险**：orders 表结构演进时 payment 会静默受影响；"微服务"叙事在面试中会被追问。
- **修复建议**：登记项，不动代码；面试话术准备好"为什么这样取舍 + 正解是 order-service 提供内部查询接口"。
- **是否必须立即修复**：否（M3 已登记，需用户批准）。

heading: 7. AI 库存助手专项审查
text:
7. AI 库存助手专项审查

**等级：B+**——具备部分 Agent 特征；审批、执行闭环和审计是完整的（这点强于典型 B），并且 C3 已补上受控只读工具循环。它仍弱于 A：没有自主触发、多步规划、跨请求记忆或写工具，所有库存变更仍必须 human-in-the-loop。

heading: 9. 数据一致性与事务专项审查
text:
9. 数据一致性与事务专项审查

1. **下单与扣库存不是原子的**（P1-2/M2）：远程扣减 + 本地插入两段，失败序列产生孤儿锁定库存。
2. **库存负数：不可能**。唯一减少 availableStock 的路径是带 `availableStock >= :quantity` 谓词的 UPDATE 和带非负守卫 + `@Version` 的 `adjustAvailableStock`。
3. **重复扣库存：基本不可能**。同 orderNo 重复扣减被 `(order_no, change_type)` 唯一约束在同事务内回滚（仅错误码不友好，P3-8）。
4. **订单成功但扣减失败：不可能**——扣减在前，扣减失败下单直接失败。
5. **扣减成功但订单失败：可能**（即 M2），且无自动回收。
6. **并发风险**：取消 vs 支付成功（P1-1，真实存在）；入库并发确认由 requestId + DRAFT 状态检查 + Inventory `@Version` 保护；并发 adjust 由 `@Version` 保护（输给的一方收到 40900 可重试）。
7. **锁与约束建议**：库存侧已经齐了（条件 UPDATE + 乐观锁 + 两个唯一约束）；缺的只是 `orders` 的 `@Version` 或取消路径的条件更新——这是本报告最推荐的一处代码修改。

heading: 11. 测试覆盖专项审查
text:
11. 测试覆盖专项审查

**已覆盖**：订单状态机、下单幂等（锁 + 唯一键回放）、超时取消（含回归测试）、支付事件消费幂等、AI 校验器（validation 包）、AI provider 契约（含 DeepSeek/MiniMax 的 HTTP 层）、admin 控制器鉴权与分页、入库/建议生命周期、Phase 3 全回路验收测试（`Phase3AiLoopAcceptanceTest`）、网关过滤器、前端 117 个单测、CI 全 reactor `mvn test`。

**缺口**：并发路径、跨服务真实（非 mock）链路、M2 失败序列、中文模型输出穿透校验器的用例。

**最应补的 10 个用例**（前 4 个能直接暴露现存 bug）：
1. 并发 cancel 与 payment-success 消费同一订单 → 断言终态不可能是"PAID 被覆盖为 CANCELLED"（**当前会失败，暴露 P1-1**）。
2. 订单已 CANCELLED 后 pay 的完整时序（pay 校验通过后订单被取消）→ 断言系统产生可观测的对账信号（**当前只有 ignored 日志，暴露 P1-1 方向 2**）。
3. deduct 成功后订单插入抛异常 → 断言锁定库存被回收或产生对账记录（**当前失败，暴露 M2**）。
4. 同 requestId 调整不同 productId → 断言第二次调整生效或明确报错（**当前静默吞掉，暴露 P2-3**）。
5. 中文库存变更声明（"库存已更新"）过 `AiModelOutputValidator` → 断言 fail（**当前通过，暴露 P2-2**）。
6. 并发两次 confirm 同一入库单（不同 requestId）→ 断言库存只加一次（Phase B B5 已固化）。
7. 并发 N 线程扣同一商品最后 1 件 → 断言恰好一单成功（Phase B B5 已固化）。
8. DISABLED 用户登录 → 断言 40300（暴露 P3-1，Phase B B4 已修复）。
9. 重复 pay 同 idempotencyKey → 明确期望语义（幂等重放 or 409）并固化。
10. Redis 不可用时下单 → 断言返回受控 50000 而非未定义行为（Phase B B5 已固化）。

heading: Phase B：增强稳定性
text:
Phase B：增强稳定性

- **目标**：一致性语义补齐、测试补盲。
- **范围**：P2-1（afterCommit 发布）、P2-3（exists 加 productId）、P2-4（支付幂等重放）、P3-1（登录状态校验）、测试清单 3–10；M2 若获批，做"先插单后扣减"或对账任务。
- **风险**：M2 属登记项，必须先获用户明确批准；其余低风险。
- **验收**：测试清单全绿；dev-log 记录；契约文档无需变更（无 API 形状变化，除 P2-4 需同步文档）。
- **修复状态（2026-07-06）**：Phase B B1-B5 已完成并验证通过；B6/M2
  仍是决策门，待批准，未实施；清单 3 随 B6 搁置，清单 5 归 Phase C。

heading: 14. 最终判断
text:
14. 最终判断

1. **可写入简历的最低标准：已达到。** 边界模型、幂等设计、审计闭环、CI、双前端都是真实可验证的。
2. **综合实训展示的最低标准：已达到**，且有现成的 demo-runbook 和 MOCK 全回路。
3. **距离"较强简历项目"差什么**：① C5 演示脚本尚未完成，失败分类展示还不能一键复现；② M2 仍是已登记的 saga 缺口，是否修复需要用户明确批准；③ 真实 provider 完整演示前需要把 `.env` 的 `AI_MODEL` 改为 provider 支持值，并准备好 M4 数据外发说明。
4. **只能修 5 件事**：① P1-1 取消/支付竞争（加 `@Version`/条件更新）；② 测试用例 1–3（并发 + M2 失败序列）；③ P2-2 校验器中文规则；④ P2-3 adjust 幂等按 productId 区分；⑤ P3-1 登录状态校验（一行级改动，消除潜伏项）。
5. **只能演示 3 条链路**：① 客户端全链路：下单 → 库存锁定 → 超时/取消释放 → 支付 → 事件驱动 PAID（展示幂等与状态机）；② AI 全回路：制造低库存 → 分析 → 生成建议 → 审批 → 转草稿 → 确认入库 → 库存变化 + 审计日志（展示"AI 不碰库存"的安全边界，这是最差异化的一条）；③ 安全边界演示：伪造 X-User-Role 打服务端口被拒、`/internal` 经网关 403、USER token 打 admin API 403（现场用 curl 打，说服力最强）。

**需要进一步验证的事项汇总**（未计入定级）：`JdbcAdminAuditWriter` 失败时对业务事务的影响；AI 问答 limit 参数是否有上限注解；分析/问答类 provider 调用是否有独立持久化日志。

heading: 所有阶段共同遵守的流程约束（来自 CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md）
text:
所有阶段共同遵守的流程约束（来自 CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md）

1. 一次只实施一个任务/子任务，动手前先对照本规划确认范围。
2. 任何后端文件改动后，提交前必须跑全 reactor `mvn clean package -DskipTests`
   （单模块测试通过不算数），同时跑改动范围内最小的相关测试。
3. 前端文件改动后必须 `npm run build` + 运行 gateway-contract 审计。

heading: 1. 背景与目标
text:
1. 背景与目标

体检报告 P1-1 确认了订单取消与支付成功之间的双向并发竞争：

- **方向 1（数据损坏，必须修）**：`OrderCommandService.cancel()` 是
  "内存读状态 → 远程释放库存 → 无条件 `saveAndFlush`"，`orders` 表没有
  `@Version`；支付成功消费者 `PaymentSuccessEventConsumer` 同样用无条件
  `saveAndFlush` 写 PAID。两个写者最后提交者赢，可能出现 PAID 被覆盖为
  CANCELLED（已收款订单被取消、库存被释放），或 CANCELLED 被覆盖为 PAID
  （超时已释放库存的订单被标记为已支付）。
- **方向 2（设计缺口，本阶段只做可观测性）**：支付校验通过后订单被
  取消/超时，支付照常 SUCCESS，消费者对 CANCELLED 订单只记 "ignored"。
  系统无退款路径，本阶段不引入退款，只把该窗口变成可观测、可对账的信号，
  并文档化为已知限制。

**目标**：Phase A 完成后，订单状态机的每一次状态迁移都是原子的
compare-and-swap，任何交错顺序下终态都合法；paid-but-cancelled 窗口留下
明确的告警与对账记录。

heading: 备选方案（不采用，记录原因）：给 `Order` 加 `@Version`
text:
备选方案（不采用，记录原因）：给 `Order` 加 `@Version`

需要新增迁移 `V13__add_order_version.sql`；且存在一个隐蔽陷阱——超时路径的
`@Modifying` 批量 UPDATE 不走乐观锁、也不递增 version，除非在 JPQL 里手写
`version = version + 1`，否则"批量更新后、持有旧实体的 saveAndFlush"仍然
可以覆盖批量更新的结果，等于没修。要做对就必须同时改批量语句，复杂度高于
CAS 方案且收益相同。**不采用。**

heading: 任务 A3：paid-but-cancelled 可观测性（方向 2）
text:
任务 A3：paid-but-cancelled 可观测性（方向 2）

涉及文件：
- `order-service/src/main/java/com/minimall/order/messaging/PaymentSuccessEventConsumer.java`
- `README.md`（Known Limitations 节）、`README.zh-CN.md`（已知限制节）

改动设计：
1. 消费者 ignored 分支中，当订单状态为 CANCELLED 时：
   `log.warn("Payment success for cancelled order, manual reconciliation
   required: orderNo={}, paymentNo={}, eventId={}", ...)`。
   orderEvent 的 payload 已含 handleResult=ignored + ignoredReason，天然是
   对账记录，无需新表。
2. README 两个语言版本的 Known Limitations 增补一条：
   "支付成功与订单取消存在极窄的竞争窗口，此时支付为 SUCCESS 而订单为
   CANCELLED；系统无退款路径，该情况会产生 WARN 日志与 ignored 订单事件
   供人工对账。"（措辞执行时润色，两个版本保持同义。）

heading: 4. 实施顺序与提交切分
text:
4. 实施顺序与提交切分

建议一次任务、一个提交（每个 commit 前走 commit gate）：

1. Commit 1：A2（repository 方法 + 消费者 CAS + A3 的 WARN）+ 对应测试。
2. Commit 2：A1（cancel CAS 化）+ 对应测试。
3. Commit 3：A3 的 README 双语增补 + 体检报告 P1-1 条目标注
   "方向 1 已修复 / 方向 2 已文档化" + dev-log。

（1、2 亦可合并为一个提交，由执行时的 diff 大小决定；A3 文档部分独立提交。）

heading: 6. 风险与回滚
text:
6. 风险与回滚

- 风险低：CAS 失败路径复用既有 40900 错误通道，前端已处理 409。
- `@Modifying(clearAutomatically = true)` 会清空持久化上下文——cancel 与
  消费者在 CAS 后若还要使用旧实体引用，必须重新查询（设计中已经如此）。
- Rabbit 消费者抛异常会导致消息重投：本方案 CAS 失败不抛异常（记 ignored），
  与现状一致，无重投行为变化。
- 回滚方式：单提交 revert 即可，无 schema 变化、无契约变化。

heading: 任务 C1（P2-2）：`AiModelOutputValidator` 中文反幻觉规则
text:
任务 C1（P2-2）：`AiModelOutputValidator` 中文反幻觉规则

涉及文件：
- `inventory-service/src/main/java/com/minimall/inventory/ai/validation/AiModelOutputValidator.java`（第 18-31 行三个 Pattern）
- `inventory-service/src/test/java/com/minimall/inventory/ai/validation/`（对应测试）

改动设计（只收紧、不放松——契约明确允许）：
1. `STOCK_CHANGE_CLAIM_PATTERN` 增补中文分支，建议起点（执行时用测试用例
   打磨，避免误杀正常表述）：
   - `库存.{0,8}(已|被)(更新|扣减|调整|增加|减少|修改|变更|应用|执行)`
   - `已(为您|帮您)?(执行|完成|应用|确认)(了)?.{0,6}(入库|补货|库存|调整|扣减)`
   - `(扣减|释放|调整|增加)(了)?库存`
2. `INTERNAL_DETAIL_PATTERN` 增补：`(密钥|秘钥|令牌|内部接口|内部端口)`。
3. SQL Pattern 不动（SQL 关键字本身是英文，现有覆盖已足够）。
4. **误杀防御**：合法输出会包含"建议补货""库存不足""低于安全库存"等表述，
   正则必须以"已发生的变更动作"为锚（"已/被 + 动词"），不得命中建议性语句。
   每条新正则配一组"必须拦截"与"必须放行"的成对用例。
5. 版本说明：这是校验器收紧，不是 prompt 变更，`promptVersion` 不需要 bump
   （在 dev-log 中明确记录这一判断依据）。

测试（对应测试清单 5）：
- 拦截组："库存已更新"、"已为您扣减库存 20 件"、"我已执行入库操作"等 →
  `AiOutputValidationException`。
- 放行组："建议补货 20 件"、"availableStock 低于 safetyStock"、
  "库存不足，存在缺货风险" → 校验通过。
- MOCK provider 全回路回归（`Phase3AiLoopAcceptanceTest`）无回归。

heading: 任务 C3（决策门）：只读 function-calling 工具循环
text:
任务 C3（决策门）：只读 function-calling 工具循环

**前置硬条件，缺一不可，否则不启动：**
1. 用户显式批准（涉及锁定契约边界：现契约禁止"自主/多 Agent 循环"，
   有界单请求工具循环是否在禁区内，必须由契约修订来裁定，不由实现者解释）。
2. 新 PRD 落到 `.taskmaster/docs/`，TaskMaster 建新任务（Phase 3 后续沿用
   `phase3-ai-inventory-assistant` tag）。
3. `docs/phase3-ai-inventory-contract.md` 在同一任务内完成契约修订。

获批后的设计边界（写入 PRD 的约束草案）：
- 仅作用于现有 `/api/admin/ai/**` 问答/分析端点，inventory-service 内实现，
  不新建服务。
- 工具白名单只含只读操作，首版两个：
  `get_inventory(productId)`、`get_recent_records(productId, limit≤10)`；
  productId 必须命中库存表白名单，否则拒绝该工具调用并计入 limitations。
- 循环上限 2 轮，超限即以已有证据作答；工具结果作为结构化 JSON 注入下一轮。
- 最终输出仍必须通过 `AiModelOutputValidator`（含 C1 中文规则）——工具循环
  不开辟任何绕过校验的出口。
- prompt 升 v3（版本化模板目录新增，不覆盖 v2）。
- 工具调用全程落入 C4 的调用日志（每轮：工具名、入参、结果摘要、耗时）。
- MOCK provider 同步实现确定性的工具调用剧本，保证离线演示。

修复状态（2026-07-08）：C3 已完成。TaskMaster Task 15-22 已落地
锁定契约修订、只读工具注册表、v3 Q&A envelope、`AI_TOOL_LOOP_*`
配置、bounded backend-owned tool loop、MOCK provider 确定性工具剧本、
工具 trace 持久化、ask 响应 `toolTrace`/`toolRounds`、admin-frontend
trace 展示、guardrail 回归、MOCK 本地验收和 C3 收尾文档。C3 验收以
`Phase3AiLoopAcceptanceTest.mockQaToolLoopReturnsTraceAndPersistsInvocationEvidence`
证明：真实 admin ask API 在 MOCK provider 下执行 1 轮后端只读
`getInventory` 工具，响应返回 trace，`ai_invocation_logs.tool_trace_json`
持久化同一 trace，库存和 `inventory_records` 不变。真实 provider smoke
在本次收尾中已完成最小连通验证：第一次使用 `.env` 原始 `AI_MODEL`
到达 DeepSeek 但返回 HTTP 400，因为该行带行内注释且清理后的
`deepseek-chat` 不被当前 API 接受；第二次使用同一 base URL/API key 和临时
`deepseek-v4-flash` model override 返回 HTTP 200、provider request id/model
存在、响应内容为可解析 JSON。该 smoke 只发送 `{"ok": true}` 连通性提示，
不包含库存/销量/商品/订单/管理员数据；完整真实 provider 演示前需把
`.env` 的 `AI_MODEL` 改成 provider 支持值且不要带行内注释。

heading: 6. 明确不做
text:
6. 明确不做

heading: 总结
text:
总结

P0：未在已跟踪仓库文件中发现。

P1：4 项，P1-01 已完成 Docker build context allowlist 修复，P1-02/P1-04 已提供受支持 demo bootstrap 路径，P1-03 已改为默认 fail-closed 内部信任模型。P1 项目前均保留为审计追踪项。

P2：12 项，P2-01/P2-02/P2-03/P2-04/P2-05/P2-06/P2-07/P2-08/P2-09/P2-10/P2-11/P2-12 均已完成基础修复。

正向结论：
- 已跟踪文件中未发现形态像真实云密钥、私钥、GitHub token 或 LLM API key 的内容；命中项为测试 secret、占位符或前端表单字段。
- 浏览器源码未绕过 gateway。前端 API client 只使用 `VITE_API_BASE_URL` 和 `/api/**`，未发现 Vue/TS 源码发送 `X-User-Id`、`X-Username`、`X-User-Role`、`X-Internal-Token`。
- Gateway 会清理浏览器传入的 trusted propagation headers 和 forwarded/audit IP headers，并在配置内部 token 后由服务端注入内部 header 与可信 client IP。
- AI 库存代码遵守锁定边界：模型输出经过 `AiModelOutputValidator`，AI API 只持久化建议/草稿，不直接更新库存、不执行 SQL、不调用 `/internal/**`、不确认入库单。
- REST controller 审查未发现面向浏览器的用户/admin API 绕过 `ApiResponse` 返回裸响应；admin 列表面使用 `PageResponse<T>`。

- 这不是生产级 schema migration 方案；生产/长期部署仍应考虑 Flyway/Liquibase 或明确的发布迁移流程。

- 各服务 `application.yml` 使用 `ddl-auto: none` 或等效默认值。
- Java 服务镜像从 `target` 复制预构建 JAR，Dockerfile 内不执行 Maven build。
- `README.md` 和 `docs/deployment.md` 记录了启动服务前需要手动执行 migration 和 `mvn clean package -DskipTests`。

风险：
- 原生 `docker compose --profile services up -d --build` 仍不是完整 schema migration 方案。
- 本地已有 volume 仍可能掩盖 schema 状态；demo 路径通过显式 migration 和可选 `--reset-volumes` 降低该风险。

修改建议：
- 对演示路径，使用 `docs/demo-runbook.md` 和 `scripts/bootstrap-demo.sh`。
- 对生产/长期部署，继续建议明确发布迁移方案：
  - 引入 Flyway/Liquibase，由服务启动时迁移 schema；或
  - 在部署流水线中显式执行有序、幂等的 SQL migration。
- 文档中明确“破坏性冷启动”指新 volume 加 migration 执行。
- 在 CI 中增加非破坏性的 migration 顺序校验，并校验 JPA 引用的表存在于 SQL migration 集合中。

文件路径：

证据：
- 修复前：product 与 inventory 的 admin audit context 会从 `X-Forwarded-For` 提取 client IP。
- 修复前：Gateway rate limit 默认 `trust-forwarded-for=false`，但下游 audit helper 仍使用 forwarded 值。
- 已更新：gateway 会剥离浏览器传入的 `X-Forwarded-For` 和 `X-Gateway-Client-Ip`，再注入 gateway 解析出的 `X-Gateway-Client-Ip`。
- 已更新：common-auth 只有在 `X-Internal-Token` 匹配时才把请求标记为可信 gateway 请求；product/inventory 只有看到该可信标记时才采信 `X-Gateway-Client-Ip`，否则回退到 servlet `remoteAddr`。

风险：
- 默认路径下，浏览器伪造的 forwarded/audit IP header 不再控制 admin 审计 IP。
- 若部署在可信反向代理后并显式开启 forwarded-for 信任，gateway 会取第一段作为可信 client IP；该开关仍需只在可信代理拓扑中使用。

修改建议：
- 保持 downstream audit helper 只读取 gateway 标记过的可信 client IP；不要在服务内重新解析原始 `X-Forwarded-For`。
- 保持 `minimall.gateway.rate-limit.trust-forwarded-for=false` 作为默认值；仅在真实可信反向代理前置时开启。

heading: What It Does
text:
What It Does

`scripts/bootstrap-demo.sh` performs the full local demo setup:

1. Starts MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Prometheus, and Grafana.
2. Applies all SQL migrations from `docs/sql/migrations` in `sort -V` order.
3. Builds all Java service JARs with `mvn clean package -DskipTests`.
4. Builds and starts all Java services with `docker compose --profile services`.
5. Runs `scripts/demo-smoke.sh` through the api-gateway.

The smoke check verifies:

- Gateway health.
- Admin login through `POST /api/admin/login`.
- Admin identity through `GET /api/admin/me`.
- Product list and demo product detail.
- Demo inventory detail for `PH3-AI-LOW-TEA`.
- Admin AI current evidence and daily report endpoints.

heading: Start Demo
text:
Start Demo

From the repository root:

```bash
scripts/bootstrap-demo.sh --env-file .env.demo
```

For a fresh destructive local demo, explicitly reset the Compose project
volumes:

```bash
scripts/bootstrap-demo.sh --env-file .env.demo --reset-volumes
```

The reset option deletes the demo Compose volumes for the configured
`COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`. Use it only when local demo data can be discarded.

heading: Frontend
text:
Frontend

After the bootstrap completes, run the frontends in separate terminals:

```bash
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
cd admin-frontend && npm install && npm run dev
```

Both frontends should keep `VITE_API_BASE_URL` pointed at the api-gateway, not
at service ports.

heading: Deployment And Operations
text:
Deployment And Operations

This guide covers the local delivery path for MiniMall Order: dependencies,
service startup order, environment variables, health checks, database migration,
RabbitMQ events, observability, and pressure-test entrypoints.

heading: Environment Variable Map
text:
Environment Variable Map

| Area | Variables | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MySQL container | `MYSQL_PORT`, `MYSQL_DATABASE`, `MYSQL_USER`, `MYSQL_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD` | Docker Compose `mysql`; Java datasource mapping. |
| Redis container | `REDIS_PORT`, `REDIS_PASSWORD` | Docker Compose `redis`; product cache; gateway rate limiting; order idempotency/locks. |
| RabbitMQ container | `RABBITMQ_AMQP_PORT`, `RABBITMQ_MANAGEMENT_PORT`, `RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER`, `RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS` | Docker Compose `rabbitmq`; payment event publisher/consumers. |
| Observability | `PROMETHEUS_IMAGE`, `PROMETHEUS_PORT`, `GRAFANA_IMAGE`, `GRAFANA_PORT`, `GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER`, `GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD`, `GRAFANA_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP`, `GRAFANA_PROMETHEUS_URL` | Prometheus and Grafana containers. |
| Java images | `JAVA_RUNTIME_IMAGE`, `JAVA_OPTS`, `MINIMALL_IMAGE_PREFIX`, `MINIMALL_IMAGE_TAG` | Compose `services` profile image build/runtime. |
| Host ports | `API_GATEWAY_PORT` | Published host port for the gateway container. Downstream service ports in `.env.example` document host-run JVM defaults; Compose keeps those services gateway-only. |
| Spring datasource | `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL`, `SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME`, `SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD` | Host-run Java services; Compose overrides these to `mysql:3306`. |
| Spring Redis | `SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST`, `SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PORT`, `SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PASSWORD` | Host-run Java services; Compose overrides these to `redis:6379`. |
| Spring RabbitMQ | `SPRING_RABBITMQ_HOST`, `SPRING_RABBITMQ_PORT`, `SPRING_RABBITMQ_USERNAME`, `SPRING_RABBITMQ_PASSWORD`, `SPRING_RABBITMQ_VIRTUAL_HOST` | Host-run Java services; Compose overrides these to `rabbitmq:5672`. |
| Service base URLs | `USER_SERVICE_BASE_URL`, `PRODUCT_SERVICE_BASE_URL`, `INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL`, `ORDER_SERVICE_BASE_URL`, `PAYMENT_SERVICE_BASE_URL`, `NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_BASE_URL` | Gateway routes and service-to-service clients. Compose injects service-name URLs; host-run Java services should source local URLs from `.env`. |
| Auth | `MINIMALL_AUTH_JWT_SECRET`, `MINIMALL_AUTH_JWT_EXPIRE_SECONDS` | `common-auth`, `user-service`, `api-gateway`. |
| Gateway CORS | `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN_PATTERNS`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_CORS_ALLOWED_METHODS`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_CORS_MAX_AGE` | `api-gateway`. |
| Gateway rate limit | `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_REPLENISH_RATE`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_BURST_CAPACITY`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTED_TOKENS`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PREFIX`, `MINIMALL_GATEWAY_RATE_LIMIT_FAIL_OPEN` | `api-gateway`. |
| Order operations | `MINIMALL_ORDER_TIMEOUT_ENABLED`, `MINIMALL_ORDER_TIMEOUT_FIXED_DELAY`, `MINIMALL_ORDER_TIMEOUT_BATCH_SIZE`, `ORDER_PAYMENT_EXPIRE_SECONDS`, `ORDER_IDEMPOTENCY_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS` | `order-service`. |

heading: Health Checks
text:
Health Checks

Check container health:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env --profile services ps
```

Check the gateway from the host:

```bash
curl --noproxy '*' -fsS http://127.0.0.1:${API_GATEWAY_PORT}/actuator/health
```

If the shell does not expand `.env` values automatically, use the configured
port directly, for example `8080` with the default `.env.example` template.

Check a service from inside the Compose network:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env exec -T prometheus wget -q -O - http://inventory-service:8103/actuator/health
```

Check Prometheus target status:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env exec -T prometheus promtool query instant http://127.0.0.1:9090 up
```

heading: Pressure Test Entry Point
text:
Pressure Test Entry Point

The k6 script is:

```text
pressure/mini-mall-gateway.js
```

It must target the gateway:

```bash
BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080 USERNAME=load-user PASSWORD=local-password PRODUCT_ID=SKU-001 VUS=1 DURATION=10s RAMP_UP=1s RAMP_DOWN=1s k6 run pressure/mini-mall-gateway.js
```

Before a real run, seed or create:

- A user that can log in through `POST /api/users/login`
- At least one `ON_SHELF` product
- Inventory for the selected product

Detailed k6 variables, thresholds, expected business failures, and bottleneck
notes are in `pressure/README.md`.

Phase 1 Task 5 (prereq) - Open catalog reads at the api-gateway for guest browsing

- Date: 2026-05-22
- Status: Done
- Branch: feature/phase1-customer-frontend
- Backend change (explicitly approved by the user): Phase 1 PRD section 4.1 requires guests (unauthenticated) to browse the product list, view product detail, and view inventory. The api-gateway's GatewayAuthenticationFilter previously bypassed authentication only for OPTIONS, non-/api/ paths, /api/users/login, and /api/users/register, so every catalog read returned 401 Missing token without a JWT - a hard contradiction with the PRD that could not be satisfied by frontend-only work. Discovered while live-verifying Task 5 against the running Docker Compose backend (GET /api/products returned 40100 without a token, 200 with one). Per CLAUDE.md (no backend changes without explicit request), surfaced the conflict and the user approved opening the read endpoints.
- Implemented: Added isPublicCatalogRead(request, path) to GatewayAuthenticationFilter, invoked from shouldBypassAuthentication. It bypasses JWT only for GET requests to /api/products, /api/products/** (detail), and /api/inventories/** (stock). All non-GET methods stay authenticated, so product create/update (POST/PUT) and on-shelf/off-shelf (POST) plus every order/payment route remain protected. Existing header sanitization still strips any spoofed X-User-Id/X-Username before the bypass, so public reads carry no forged identity. /internal/** remains blocked by GatewayInternalPathBlockFilter (unchanged).
- Changed files: api-gateway/src/main/java/com/minimall/gateway/security/GatewayAuthenticationFilter.java; api-gateway/src/test/java/com/minimall/gateway/GatewayAuthenticationFilterTest.java; api-gateway/src/test/java/com/minimall/gateway/GatewayIntegrationRegressionTest.java; docs/dev-log.md
- Commands run: read of ProductController/InventoryController mappings (only GET list+detail and GET /{productId} are reads; mutations are POST/PUT) and GatewayAuthConfig; mvn -pl api-gateway -am test; mvn -pl api-gateway -am package -DskipTests; docker compose --env-file .env.example --profile services up -d --build api-gateway; anonymous curl smokes for products/inventories (GET) and products POST + orders/my GET (must stay 401)
- Test result: mvn -pl api-gateway test passed 30/30 (4 new auth-filter cases: public product list strips spoofed headers, public product detail bypass, public inventory bypass, product POST still 401; plus the GatewayIntegrationRegressionTest updated so product/inventory GET are public reads keyed ip:unknown rather than protected user:42 routes). After repackaging the jar and rebuilding the gateway image, live curl confirmed anonymous GET /api/products and GET /api/inventories/{id} return 200 with data, while anonymous POST /api/products and GET /api/orders/my still return 401 Missing token.
- Issues: The first image rebuild served stale code because infra/docker/java-service.Dockerfile only copies a prebuilt target/*.jar (no in-container compile); running mvn test alone did not refresh the jar. Fixed by mvn package before docker build. The IDE flags @RequestMapping on the tests' TestDownstreamController as a non-precise mapping, but it intentionally handles both GET and POST for the downstream stub, so it is left as-is.
- Next: commit Task 5 frontend (product list page + ProductCard).

heading: Phase 1 Task 6 - Implement product detail and inventory display
text:
Phase 1 Task 6 - Implement product detail and inventory display

- Date: 2026-05-23
- Status: Done
- Branch: feature/phase1-customer-frontend
- TaskMaster tag: phase1-customer-frontend
- Implemented: Replaced the ProductDetailView placeholder with the customer product detail page at /products/:productId, backed by the Task 2 product/inventory api clients (no changes to api/product.ts/api/inventory.ts/router/types - consume only). On mount loads product (GET /api/products/{productId}) and inventory (GET /api/inventories/{productId}) concurrently via Promise.allSettled so a transient inventory error does not blank out the product detail (and vice-versa); reloads on productId param change for in-route SPA navigation. Two-column layout (el-row md 14/10, stacked on xs): left card shows name, status tag (在售 / 已下架), price (¥X.XX, red 28px), productId meta, and the description with whitespace-pre-wrap; right card shows the stockState as a localized tag (IN_STOCK 有货 success / OUT_OF_STOCK 无货 danger / INACTIVE 未上架 info), availableStock and lockedStock rows, then a quantity selector (el-input-number, min=1, max=availableStock or 1 when none, precision 0, step 1, disabled when product off-shelf / no inventory / not IN_STOCK) and a full-width 立即下单 primary button. canOrder requires product ON_SHELF AND inventory present AND stockState IN_STOCK AND quantity integer in [1, availableStock]; quantity is also clamped via a watcher whenever availableStock changes so a refresh that lowers stock cannot leave a stale invalid value. Disabled reason is surfaced under the button (off-shelf > inventory unavailable > INACTIVE > OUT_OF_STOCK/availableStock<=0 > quantity out of range) so the user sees why the button is greyed. Three terminal states beyond success: (a) 404/PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND -> el-result icon=warning '商品不存在' + 返回商品列表; (b) other product load error -> el-result error + 重试 + 返回; (c) inventory-only error -> inline el-alert + small 重试加载库存 button inside the right card, leaving the rest of the page visible. onOrder gates by auth.isLoggedIn: unauthenticated users go to /login?redirect=<route.fullPath> (so the guard restores them right back); authenticated users go to /checkout?productId=...&quantity=... (the /checkout page itself remains the Task 7 placeholder and is not wired up to POST /api/orders yet).
- Changed files: frontend/src/views/ProductDetailView.vue; .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json; docs/dev-log.md
- Commands run: node read of .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json (task-master CLI not installed in this shell) to confirm Task 6 scope; reads of router/api/product.ts/api/inventory.ts/types/product.ts/types/inventory.ts/types/api.ts/stores/auth.ts/api/http.ts/components/ProductCard.vue to verify the contract before editing; npm run build; ss -ltn :5173 / :8080 probes; anonymous curl --noproxy '*' http://localhost:8080/api/products and /api/inventories/{id} to confirm gateway+backend up and the catalog reads return ApiResponse data; npm run dev (background on :5173) for the user to do the manual browser smoke
- Test result: npm run build (vue-tsc --noEmit + vite build) passed; ProductDetailView emits as its own lazy chunk (5.88 kB). Backend reachable: gateway 200 on anonymous GET /api/products (4 seeded ON_SHELF products) and /api/inventories/PHASE0-SMOKE-20260521 (availableStock=49, lockedStock=1, IN_STOCK). Manual browser smoke run by the user against the running Docker Compose backend covered: success path, quantity bounds (1..availableStock), unauthenticated 立即下单 -> /login?redirect=..., authenticated -> /checkout?productId=...&quantity=..., 商品不存在 path, and the disabled-button hint copy. No type errors or runtime console errors observed.
- Issues: The pre-existing Element Plus full-import main-chunk >500kB warning persists (out of scope). The 立即下单 button currently only routes to /checkout - the actual POST /api/orders + inventory deduction round-trip is Task 7 scope and is intentionally NOT implemented here (per CLAUDE.md "do not implement future tasks early"); the backend inventory deduction logic itself already exists from Phase 0.
- Next: Phase 1 Task 7 - Implement order creation and checkout flow.

heading: Phase 1 Task 8 - Implement my orders order detail and cancellation
text:
Phase 1 Task 8 - Implement my orders order detail and cancellation

- Date: 2026-05-23
- Status: Done
- Branch: feature/phase1-customer-frontend
- TaskMaster tag: phase1-customer-frontend
- Implemented: Replaced the OrdersView and OrderDetailView placeholders with the customer-facing "我的订单" surface backed by Task 2's typed order api client only (no changes to api/order.ts/types/order.ts/router/http/auth - the routes were already requiresAuth and listMyOrders/getOrder/cancelOrder were already wired). New shared util frontend/src/utils/order-status.ts: getOrderStatusMeta(status) maps each OrderStatus enum value to a Chinese label + Element Plus tag type (PENDING_PAYMENT 待支付/warning, PAID 已支付/success, CANCELLED 已取消/info, CLOSED 已关闭/info, REFUNDED 已退款/danger) with a defensive fallback (raw status + info type) so an unknown backend value never crashes the page. Reused by both views so status copy/color cannot drift between list and detail. OrdersView (/orders): reads ?page= from the URL query (1-based UI <-> 0-based backend, PAGE_SIZE 10), card-list layout consistent with the storefront brief instead of an admin table; each card shows the monospace orderNo, status tag, product summary line (first item productName x quantity, "等 N 件" when items.length > 1, dash when empty), totalAmount in red ¥ format, createdAt, and (only for PENDING_PAYMENT) the expireAt as 支付截止. Per-card actions: PENDING_PAYMENT shows 取消订单 + 去支付 (the latter routes to {name:'payment', params:{orderNo}}); all other statuses show 查看详情. Whole card click goes to the detail page; button clicks use @click.stop so they do not double-navigate. Four states: v-loading during fetch, el-empty "暂无订单" + 去逛逛 CTA -> /products, el-result error + retry on failure, and the list itself. el-pagination (background, prev/pager/next/jumper/total) is rendered only when totalElements > PAGE_SIZE; page changes router.replace({query:{page}}) without history stacking, and a watch on route.query.page re-fetches on browser back/forward. After a cancel succeeds the list reloads; if the current page goes empty (last order on a page cancelled) the view backs off to the new last available page automatically. OrderDetailView (/orders/:orderNo): loads on mount and on orderNo param change. Layout: detail head with title + monospace orderNo on the left and a large status tag on the right; "基本信息" card grid showing 下单时间, 更新时间, plus status-conditional rows (支付截止 only for PENDING_PAYMENT, 支付时间 only for PAID, 关闭时间 only for CANCELLED/CLOSED); "商品明细" card listing each OrderItemSummary as productName + monospace productId, x quantity, unit price, subtotal (unitPrice * quantity), with an el-divider then the 合计 row (¥X.XX, red 28px) and a "订单金额以后端结算为准" caption. Bottom actions: PENDING_PAYMENT shows 取消订单 + 去支付; everything else shows 返回订单列表. Shared cancel flow in both views: ElMessageBox.confirm("确定要取消订单 {orderNo} 吗？此操作无法恢复", "取消订单", {type:'warning', 确认取消/再想想}) -> cancelOrder(orderNo) -> ElMessage.success('订单已取消') + reload current data; dialog dismiss is silently ignored (Promise rejection path) so no spurious toast. Business-conflict handling: ApiError.code === ORDER_INVALID_STATE (40902) or ORDER_CANCELLED (40901) -> ElMessage.warning('订单状态已变化，已为你刷新最新数据') + reload, so the user always sees the authoritative current state even when their UI was stale. Other business codes surface via ElMessage.error with the backend message; network/401/429/500 are still toasted by the http interceptor. Per-card cancel spinner is keyed by cancellingOrderNo so simultaneous cards do not all spin.
- Mid-task contract refinement: User observed that hitting another user's orderNo returned 404 '订单不存在' rather than 403. Reading order-service/.../OrderQueryService.java:28-29 confirmed this is intentional: the backend queries by composite (orderNo, userId) and throws NOT_FOUND for both "does not exist" and "exists but belongs to another user" - an authorization-aware 404 to prevent attackers from enumerating valid orderNos by observing 403/404 differences (the same pattern GitHub/AWS S3/Stripe use). The frontend's 403 branch in OrderDetailView was therefore dead code for this endpoint. Per CLAUDE.md ("Don't add error handling for scenarios that can't happen" / "Trust internal code and framework guarantees") and with explicit user approval, removed the loadError 'forbidden' variant, the 403 detection in the catch block, and the corresponding el-result block; added a one-line comment in the catch block documenting the authorization-aware 404 contract so future maintainers don't reintroduce a 403 branch.
- Changed files: frontend/src/utils/order-status.ts (NEW); frontend/src/views/OrdersView.vue; frontend/src/views/OrderDetailView.vue; .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json; docs/dev-log.md
- Commands run: node read of .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json for Task 8 scope; reads of OrdersView/OrderDetailView placeholders, api/order.ts, types/order.ts, types/api.ts (ErrorCode constants) before editing; npm run build (twice - initial implementation and after the 403-branch removal); read of order-service OrderQueryService.java to confirm the backend's NOT_FOUND-for-cross-user behavior is deliberate; ss -ltn :5173 probe; anonymous curl --noproxy '*' http://localhost:8080/api/inventories/PHASE0-SMOKE-20260521 to confirm backend still healthy
- Test result: npm run build (vue-tsc --noEmit + vite build) passed; OrdersView lazy chunk 4.55 kB, OrderDetailView 5.83 kB, order-status util 0.29 kB. Full manual browser smoke against the running Docker Compose backend by the user covered all 14 cases (originally 15 - cases #10 and #11 collapsed into one "order-not-found-or-not-yours" path after the contract refinement): list display + status tag colors, button visibility gated on PENDING_PAYMENT only, cancel-with-confirm dialog (confirm + dismiss paths), per-card cancel spinner + list refresh, whole-card click vs button @click.stop, detail full-field rendering with status-conditional time fields, detail cancel reload, 去支付 navigation to the Task 9 placeholder, 404/cross-user both showing '订单不存在', empty-list state on a fresh account, ?page= URL sync + browser back/forward, unauthenticated guard redirect to /login?redirect=. No type errors, no runtime console errors.
- Issues: The pre-existing Element Plus full-import main-chunk >500kB warning persists (out of scope). The cancel-conflict 40901/40902 path was not exercised live (would require either two browser sessions cancelling concurrently or hitting a natural 15-min expiry mid-cancel); the handler is covered by construction - same try/catch shape as the verified cancel-success path - and surfaces 'ElMessage.warning + reload'. The 去支付 destination is the Task 9 placeholder; Task 9 will replace it. PaymentResponse fields (paidAt etc.) come straight from the backend - if backend ever adds a SHIPPED / COMPLETED status, the defensive util fallback ('show raw status with info color') keeps the page rendering until the util is updated.
- Next: Phase 1 Task 9 - Implement mock payment flow and payment result pages.

heading: Phase 1 Task 10 - Finalize global UX verification and frontend documentation
text:
Phase 1 Task 10 - Finalize global UX verification and frontend documentation

- Date: 2026-05-23
- Status: Done
- Branch: feature/phase1-customer-frontend
- TaskMaster tag: phase1-customer-frontend
- Implemented: Phase 1 customer-frontend acceptance and documentation. No business-code edits beyond one regression fix surfaced by the final E2E (see below). New doc docs/phase1-frontend-acceptance.md (~210 lines) is the closing acceptance record: scope (in/out), Pages & Routes table (matches src/router/index.ts), full state matrix (8 customer views x loading/empty/error/success/disabled/submitting/unauthorized - no gaps), security audit results, the exact /api/** endpoints the frontend calls, idempotency contract (single crypto.randomUUID per mount, NOT regenerated on failure, router.replace on success), mock payment clarification (channel:'MOCK' + permanent banner + 5x800ms poll + success-pending fallback), verification commands, 15-step manual E2E smoke checklist, build artifact summary, known limits, and an explicit confirmation that admin/RBAC/cart/address/coupon/real-payment/refund/reconciliation/backend-lifecycle-expansion were NOT introduced. frontend/README.md picks up a Pages & Routes table, an API/auth contract section (canonical /api/**, JWT-via-Authorization, 401-clears-token, authorization-aware 404), an idempotency section, and a mock-payment section so a new contributor lands on the right mental model. Root README.md picks up two new lines in the Documentation Map - frontend/README.md and docs/phase1-frontend-acceptance.md - so the discovery path from the top of the repo is complete.
- Audits run during Task 10:
  - Security grep (frontend/src/): X-User-Id/X-Username -> 0 matches; /internal/ -> 0 matches; :8101-:8106 -> 0 matches; baseURL source -> only import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL (http.ts:12). 401 -> clearToken + redirect to /login (http.ts:54-57); 429 -> friendly toast (http.ts:61-63); 500 -> generic toast. Token storage: localStorage key minimall_token only.
  - State-matrix audit across LoginView, RegisterView, ProductListView, ProductDetailView, CheckoutView, OrdersView, OrderDetailView, PaymentView - all seven states covered where applicable, no gaps. Status copy/color shared via utils/order-status.ts so list and detail cannot drift.
- Mid-task regression fix (single line, frontend-only, recorded with explicit user approval): The Task 8 OrdersView was calling listMyOrders with only {page, size} - no sort. The backend OrderController.myOrders(Pageable) does not declare a @PageableDefault, so Spring forwarded an unsorted Pageable and the repository's findByUserId returned rows in primary-key ASC order (oldest first), surfacing as "newest order is at the bottom" during the live E2E. Fixed in frontend/src/views/OrdersView.vue:39 by adding sort: 'createdAt,desc' to the listMyOrders params; PageParams already supported the field (types/api.ts:19), backend Pageable resolver auto-parses sort=createdAt,desc with no backend change. Per the Phase 1 boundary (CLAUDE.md "do not modify backend business logic unless explicitly requested") the fix is frontend-only; the backend default is left intact because changing it would silently rewrite the contract for any other current/future caller. Documented in the acceptance doc Section 5 (API contract row for /api/orders/my). type-check (vue-tsc --noEmit) passed; user verified /orders now lists newest first via HMR refresh without restarting Vite.
- Changed files: docs/phase1-frontend-acceptance.md (NEW); frontend/README.md (sections added); README.md (Documentation Map entries); frontend/src/views/OrdersView.vue (one-line sort fix); .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json (Task 10 done, completedCount 10); docs/dev-log.md (this entry)
- Commands run: 4 security greps across frontend/src/ (X-User-Id|X-Username, /internal/, :810[1-6]); reads of every customer view + router/http/auth-store/token-util + all 5 api/*.ts modules to build the state matrix and endpoint inventory; reads of order-service OrderController/OrderRepository/OrderQueryService to diagnose the unsorted-Pageable root cause; node-driven inspection + write of tasks.json to flip Task 10 status (task-master CLI not installed in this shell); cd into frontend then `npm run build` (vue-tsc + vite, all green) and `npm run type-check` after the sort fix (vue-tsc --noEmit clean); npm run dev in the background for the live 15-step E2E; ss -ltn / curl --noproxy '*' /actuator/health for backend reachability (gateway 200); pkill -f vite at session close (exit 143 SIGTERM, port 5173 confirmed closed via ss)
- Test result: npm run build (vue-tsc --noEmit + vite build) passed with the same chunk profile as Task 9 (PaymentView 8.89 kB, CheckoutView 6.19 kB, OrderDetailView 5.83 kB, ProductDetailView 5.87 kB, OrdersView 4.55 kB, ProductListView 3.69 kB, RegisterView 3.55 kB, LoginView 2.31 kB, order-status util 0.29 kB). Full 15-step manual E2E smoke run by the user against the running Docker Compose backend: steps 1-7 (catalog -> detail -> guard-redirect -> register -> login -> checkout -> order created) passed; step 8 (newest at top of /orders) initially failed -> root-caused -> fixed via the one-line sort fix above -> user reloaded /orders via HMR and confirmed newest now at top; steps 9-14 (mock-pay -> PAID transition observed inside the 5x800ms poll window -> receipt rendered -> list reflects PAID -> authorization-aware 404 on a foreign orderNo -> logout -> guard redirect to /login?redirect=/orders -> re-login restores /orders) all passed. Step 15 (DevTools localStorage inspection) was explicitly skipped as optional and is not blocking; minimall_token is the only key written by the frontend per utils/token.ts.
- Issues: The pre-existing Element Plus full-import main-chunk >500 kB warning persists (out of scope; recorded in Tasks 5-9 and the acceptance doc). The cancel-conflict 40901/40902 path and the payment polling-timeout success-pending fallback remain not-exercised-live (covered by construction; recorded in the acceptance doc Known Limits section). Idempotency keys reset on hard reload (per the Task 7 contract; recorded in Known Limits). The /403 route is reserved but not currently emitted by any flow because the backend uses authorization-aware 404 for cross-user reads.
- Next: Phase 1 customer frontend is complete. Phase 1 closing artifacts are in place. Future work is out of Phase 1 scope (e.g. cart/address/coupon/real-payment/refund/admin/RBAC) and should start a new PRD + TaskMaster tag.

heading: Phase 1 UI rework — A1 Tokens & global base
text:
Phase 1 UI rework — A1 Tokens & global base

- Date: 2026-05-24
- Status: Done
- Branch: feature/phase1-customer-frontend
- TaskMaster tag: phase1-customer-frontend (no TaskMaster ID — UI rework is a post-Phase-1 follow-up effort governed by docs/phase1-ui-redesign.md, not a TaskMaster task. Phase 1 was already 10/10 at start of this work.)
- Scope: First step of the Phase 1 customer frontend visual/UX rework. Establishes the design-system foundation (CSS custom properties, global base layer, type utility classes, font loading) without touching any user-facing page. Per the redesign brief (docs/phase1-ui-redesign.md §8 Phase A1), A1 is required to be a zero-visual-regression step so the foundation can be reviewed independently of the page rewrites that follow in Phase B.
- Implemented:
  - NEW frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (~115 lines) — declares the full design-system token surface as :root CSS custom properties, per the brief §2: 12 color tokens (ink-900/700/500/300/100, canvas/canvas-darker/surface, accent-terracotta + accent-terracotta-soft, success + success-soft, warn, danger + danger-soft) committing to the "ink + warm paper + single terracotta accent" voice; 3 font-family stacks (--font-sans with Inter + zh fallbacks, --font-display with Inter Tight, --font-mono); type scale variables for display-xl / display / h1 / h2 / body / body-strong / caption / mono-sm / price-md / price-lg / amount-display / brand with size, line-height, weight, and letter-spacing where defined; 10 spacing tokens on the 4px base step (4/8/12/16/20/24/32/48/64/96); 5 radius tokens (sm 6 / default 10 / md 12 / lg 16 / xl 24); 4 shadow tokens (shadow-1/2/3 + shadow-press for the focus ring); 4 motion tokens (--ease, --ease-in, --dur-1 120ms press / --dur-2 220ms hover/page-fade / --dur-3 420ms number-tween / --dur-4 800ms success ceremony). File is declaration-only — no rules apply to any selector — so importing it cannot visually change any existing page.
  - NEW frontend/src/styles/base.css (~95 lines) — global base layer per brief §2.3: box-sizing reset on *,*::before,*::after; margin/padding zero on html/body and common typographic blocks (h1-h6, p, figure, blockquote, dl, dd, ul, ol); text-size-adjust 100% on html; body adopts --font-sans + --t-body-size + var(--ink-700) text + var(--canvas) background + antialiased font smoothing + optimizeLegibility text rendering; img/svg/video/canvas/audio/iframe/embed/object set to display:block + max-width:100% to prevent inline-image baseline gaps; button reset to inherit font/color and strip native chrome; a inherits color and removes underline; :focus-visible binds a soft inset ring via var(--shadow-press) for keyboard nav only (mouse clicks are not affected); ::selection uses --accent-terracotta-soft fill with --ink-900 text; scrollbar styled via both scrollbar-width/scrollbar-color (firefox) and ::-webkit-scrollbar (chromium/safari) with a 10px track, transparent background, --ink-300 thumb darkening to --ink-500 on hover. **Important visual choice:** body's --canvas background WOULD be visible if it weren't already covered by DefaultLayout's `min-height:100vh; background:#f5f6f8` rule, which still wins on the surface area users see. This keeps A1 visually-quiet on existing pages — the canvas color will only become visible after A2 replaces the shell. Confirmed by inspection of layouts/DefaultLayout.vue.
  - NEW frontend/src/styles/typography.css (~120 lines) — utility classes (.text-display-xl, .text-display, .text-h1, .text-h2, .text-body, .text-body-strong, .text-caption, .text-mono-sm, .text-price-md, .text-price-lg, .text-amount-display, .text-brand, .tabular-nums) wiring the type-scale tokens from tokens.css into reusable class selectors. .text-price-md / .text-price-lg / .text-amount-display force tabular-nums via font-variant-numeric so columns of prices and amounts align cleanly across cards. The .tabular-nums standalone utility is provided for ad-hoc uses (order count badges, time-remaining chips). These classes are inert until a view chooses to apply them — they cannot affect any current page.
  - MODIFIED frontend/src/main.ts — added 3 new style imports (./styles/tokens.css, ./styles/base.css, ./styles/typography.css) placed AFTER `import 'element-plus/dist/index.css'`. A 5-line comment block above the imports records the cascade-direction reasoning (our overrides must come after EP so :root variables and global base styles win) and explicitly states that Phase A1 does NOT yet override Element Plus variables (deferred to end of Phase B). This is a correction relative to the initial draft of docs/phase1-ui-redesign.md, which had said "before" — both the file and the brief have now been updated.
  - MODIFIED frontend/index.html — added <link rel="preconnect"> to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (with crossorigin on the gstatic link as Google recommends), plus a single <link rel="stylesheet"> loading Inter (400/500/600/700) and Inter Tight (600/700) with display=swap. If Google Fonts is unreachable, the --font-sans / --font-display stacks fall back to PingFang SC / Hiragino Sans GB / Microsoft YaHei / system-ui — no broken rendering, just system fonts. The Inter Tight subset is intentionally narrow (only 600/700) because Inter Tight is only used for display/brand/amount text in the brief.
  - MODIFIED docs/phase1-ui-redesign.md §8 Phase A1 — synced two corrections so the brief and the implementation stay aligned: (1) clarified that style imports load AFTER Element Plus, with a parenthetical note that the earlier "before" was a cascade-direction error; (2) explicitly removed the "minimal EP variable override" from A1 and deferred it to the end of Phase B, restating A1's zero-visual-regression commitment. Also clarified that font loading happens via Google Fonts <link> tags in index.html with system-font fallbacks.
- Decisions and trade-offs:
  - A1 deliberately does NOT touch Element Plus CSS variables. The brief originally placed "minimal EP override for el-message / el-message-box / el-form-item" in A1; this was tightened to the end of Phase B during the pre-A1 plan-confirmation round so A1 can be reviewed as a pure no-op-on-pages change. This means toast and dialog colors will still match the EP default until the end of Phase B; that mismatch is acknowledged and accepted.
  - Style imports are placed AFTER `import 'element-plus/dist/index.css'`. CSS cascade direction requires our :root tokens (and any future overrides) to load last so they win.
  - DefaultLayout's existing `background: #f5f6f8` still wins over body's --canvas. This is intentional for A1 — the new canvas color will become visible only after A2 replaces the shell. Verified visually by inspecting layouts/DefaultLayout.vue.
  - Type tokens use rem-style separation (--t-{role}-size / -lh / -weight / -track) so a single token name maps to a single CSS variable, keeping utility classes simple. No fluid type (clamp()) yet — fixed sizes match the brief and avoid surprises at edge widths.
  - Google Fonts chosen over self-hosted to keep this commit small. If the user later wants to remove the CDN dependency, the change is a localized swap of the <link> tag for a self-hosted @font-face block in tokens.css or a sibling fonts.css. The --font-sans / --font-display fallback chain stays valid either way.
- Changed files: frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (NEW); frontend/src/styles/base.css (NEW); frontend/src/styles/typography.css (NEW); frontend/src/main.ts (3 imports + 5-line comment); frontend/index.html (3 <link> tags); docs/phase1-ui-redesign.md (Phase A1 paragraph synced); docs/dev-log.md (this entry); docs/phase1-ui-redesign.md is also newly tracked from the prior conversation (it was untracked before this commit).

Chunk profile is essentially unchanged from the route-reuse commit b1e5768: PaymentView 9.27 kB, CheckoutView 6.64 kB, ProductDetailView 5.87 kB (all byte-identical to the previous build), OrderDetailView 5.41 kB (vs 5.83 kB before — a rollup-hash-driven drop with no source change; OrderDetailView.vue was not edited in this commit, confirmed via `git diff --stat`). No new utility class is applied to any view, so visually pages render exactly as they did before. The font stack on body changes from the platform default to Inter, but only in places that don't have an explicit family — most page styles override this anyway, so the visible diff is at most a sub-pixel weight shift on plain text.
